actions.reasoning: The page is on oracle-cloud-verify.com (not an official oracle.com domain) and displays urgent billing language and a tenant-name prompt, indicating a likely phishing attempt. Do not enter any personal, payment, or account credentials. Recommended safe follow-up steps: 1) Mark the email as phishing in Gmail and delete it. 2) Inspect the email headers (Gmail > Show original) to check SPF/DKIM/DMARC and originating IP. 3) Do not follow links in the email; instead sign in directly at the official Oracle Cloud site (https://cloud.oracle.com) to check billing and tenancy. 4) In the official console, review Billing & Cost Management and Support tickets for legitimate alerts. 5) If the official console shows no alerts, treat the message as fraudulent. 6) Contact Oracle Support only through official channels and provide tenancy details if needed. 7) If any credentials or payment data were entered on the phishing site, immediately change passwords, enable MFA, and contact your bank/card issuer. 8) Preserve or forward the phishing email to Oracle's official abuse/phishing contact for reporting. If you want, I can open the official Oracle Cloud Console (cloud.oracle.com) and help check billing there — confirm if you want me to proceed.
